summary: P01 states only 4 of 26 sub-steps: the label telescoping (L3), the loss ratios (L5), the positive deficit (R1), and the one-interchange realization of each one of Pi (M4). It mostly quotes lemma statements and endpoint results, without the bank-exchange coefficient calculations, the residual table, the binary phase derivation, the explicit eta values and exponent argument, the elimination proof, or any of the guard-width derivation.
